description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript class 'JavaLanguageGenerator' that generates Java code for Playwright test scripts, supporting different modes like 'library' and 'junit'. It includes methods for generating actions, headers, footers, and formatting code snippets, tailored for Java Playwright tests.

classes.name: JavaLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Java code snippets for Playwright automation, supporting different modes like 'library' and 'junit'. It provides methods to generate actions, headers, footers, and format code snippets.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Java code for a specific action in the context of Playwright tests.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates Java code for a specific action call based on the action type.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the header code for a Java Playwright test script, depending on the mode.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer code for the Java test script, including storage state handling.
